morton_index.interval_semantics: sorted [start,end), complete cube, x bit first then y,z
morton_index.leaf_ids_semantics: interval row to original leaves.bin row

node_indices_semantics: original leaf row order; float leaf column 5 is always -1
query_leaf_ids_semantics: exact original leaf row per native query; float query column 10 is -1 if not exactly representable
polynomial: sum c[i+4*j+16*k] * u_x^i * u_y^j * u_z^k, u=(point-lo)/size, i,j,k=0..3
leaf_order: start grid z,y,x then depth first child x+2*y+4*z
query_points: Halton bases 2,3,5, indices 1..query_count, u=0.0001+0.9998*Halton; strictly inside bounds
native_gradient_semantics: glm::normalize(local polynomial gradient); may be nonfinite at zero gradient
raw_gradient_semantics: TriCubicInterpolation::interpolateGradient at native traversal local coordinates divided by leaf size
